a.name: Caderno de percurso
a.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Asset type: visual direction proposal for Evolua, NOT implementation or approved baseline.
Primary request: Generate ONE polished landscape presentation board labeled "A — Caderno de percurso" with a large desktop web-app mockup on the left (roughly 3/4 width) and a legible mobile adaptation on the right. Flat digital UI, no device hardware or photographic scene.
Input images: the two referenced images are current desktop/mobile app CONTENT AND WORKFLOW REFERENCES ONLY. Redesign their visual presentation. Retain ALL existing fields and actions, do not preserve generic native styling.
Art direction: Cool pearl #F6F7F4, white #FFFFFF, graphite #252A27, muted #5D6761, evergreen #31584A and control border #7B857E. Refined Newsreader-style moderate-contrast roman serif headings (no italics), Source Sans 3-style humanist sans for UI. Editorial contemporary personal development notebook, with disciplined soft 4px control corners and no decorative ruled paper. Desktop has a 5/12-width form on left and 7/12 cycle list on right, aligned after large understated 44px title. Most characteristic element is the expressive serif title and quiet green active label. Form is plain white region, cycle list is flat separated rows, not repeated cards. Mobile stacks form then list, same header, no sidebar.
Real content in Brazilian Portuguese: app name "Evolua"; main title "Ciclos de PDI"; intro "Planeje e acompanhe seus ciclos de desenvolvimento."; section "Novo ciclo"; five persistent labels "Título", "Descrição (opcional)", "Tipo de período", "Data inicial", "Data final"; type selected "Personalizado"; date fields "01/11/2026" and "31/01/2027"; primary "Criar ciclo". Section "Meus ciclos"; single filter label "Filtrar por status" selected "Todos"; three example cycles: "Comunicação e liderança", "Ativo", "01 nov 2026 a 31 jan 2027", actions "Concluir" and "Cancelar"; "Planejamento do próximo trimestre", "Rascunho", "01 fev 2027 a 30 abr 2027", actions "Iniciar" and "Cancelar"; "Organização do trabalho", "Concluído", "01 ago 2026 a 31 out 2026", NO actions. Dates, text, buttons legible and accurately spelled. Label for active status dark green on pale green, draft neutral, completed dark neutral.
Composition: left aligned text; high quality typography, refined but usable 16px UI feel; real content, functional visual grouping and 44px mobile buttons. Show mobile as vertically complete content, smaller scale than desktop but readable, not a crop concealing the form. No fake progress percentages or data visualizations. Make all 5 fields visible on desktop. No new features, top nav, account/avatar, sidebar, tabs, detail links, edit buttons, counters or new-cycle modal.
Avoid: purple/blue gradients, terracotta, gradients of any kind, uniform repeated cards, pill-heavy statuses, exaggerated shadows, newspaper columns and hairlines everywhere, numbered decoration, uppercase eyebrow labels, decorative icons, arrows appended to buttons, hero marketing content, invented sections. Do not reproduce the Next development indicator. Professional editorial PRODUCT SCREEN rather than landing page.
Output: one board showing just this named direction and its responsive adaptation, clearly distinct from other directions.
